response.overview: RiffTrax was caught up in the Twilight frenzy, and not surprisingly, given that we are staffed almost exclusively by 13-year-old girls. So when we heard rumors of the feature film-the whispers of John Goodman being cast as Edward were especially worrying-we sent so many texts beginning "OMG!!!1!!!!11!!" we nearly shut down our SMS service.
response.title: Rifftrax: Twilight
